description: Dated headlines for one symbol, one search query, or one company's SEC filings, from keyless feeds (Yahoo Finance RSS, Google News RSS, EDGAR Atom). Every item must carry a parsable timestamp inside the window; undated and out-of-window items are counted and sampled under excluded_outside_window rather than being shown as recent. Symbol-feed headlines must also name the ticker or quote-resolved issuer, and unrelated syndication noise is counted under excluded_irrelevant. Filings are the one source here that cannot be spun, so prefer them for anything material.

as_of.description: ISO date treated as now. Defaults to today.

cik.description: SEC CIK for the filings feed.

days.description: Recency window in days. Defaults to 14.

forms.description: Filing type for the CIK feed. Defaults to 8-K.

query.description: Free-text Google News query, e.g. 'HBM supply Samsung'.

symbol.description: Ticker for the Yahoo per-name feed.

name: get_news
title: Get Dated News and Filings
